release_notes: Adds a live update-status indicator to the shared sidebar footer.
Shows green when the application is up to date, red when an update is available, blue while checking, and neutral when status is unknown or unavailable.
Shows the time of the latest completed update check and points users to Data & Diagnostics for update details.
Update prompts now show the installed version, target version, and a mandatory What's New section before Download & Install.
OTA manifests with empty release notes are rejected.
Database schema remains 8; calculations, numbering, exports, document renderers, templates, revisions, and cancellation workflows are unchanged.
